literal: Even after planning methodically, only endless (unsuccessful) things will they do, those who lack capability.
translation: Those who lack capability will only produce unsuccessful results, even if they have planned their actions methodically.
modern: செயல்பாட்டுத் திறன் இல்லாதவர்கள், முறையோடு திட்டமிட்டாலும் கூட, வெற்றியில் முடியாத செயல்களையே செய்வார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that planning is futile without the practical capability to execute. Even if those who lack competence (tiraṟpāṭu ilāatavar) plan their actions methodically and systematically, their endeavors will still end in failure without reaching a successful completion. The word 'tiraṟpāṭu' refers to the inherent skill or capability required to turn plans into reality. Thus, the author shows that execution capability is just as vital as strategic planning.
